{{Top|leg}}
'''Optic sensors''' were installed in the [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. They allowed the Guard to see in complete darkness, enabling them to operate without difficulty.
